steps.en: Install the engine into a Python venv on a Linux box with an NVIDIA GPU
steps.zh: 在带 NVIDIA 显卡的 Linux 机器上把引擎装进 Python 虚拟环境

steps.en: Start the server with a local path or Hugging Face repo id
steps.zh: 用本地路径或 HF 仓库 id 启动服务

steps.en: Picks dtype, kernels, cache sizes and parsers from the checkpoint and the GPU
steps.zh: 按检查点和显卡自动选精度、算子、缓存大小与解析器

steps.en: Keeps experts in host RAM, caches hot ones on the GPU, fetches or CPU-computes misses
steps.zh: 专家常驻内存，热门的缓存在显卡上，未命中的现取或交给 CPU 算

steps.en: Serves OpenAI and Anthropic APIs on 127.0.0.1:1919
steps.zh: 在 127.0.0.1:1919 提供 OpenAI／Anthropic 接口

steps.en: Launch your coding agent against the server
steps.zh: 让你的编程智能体连到这台服务

steps.en: Writes the agent's provider config, clears cloud API keys, starts the agent
steps.zh: 写好智能体的模型配置、清掉云端 API key，然后启动智能体

value.en: Your coding agent runs on a frontier MoE model bigger than your VRAM, on your own desktop, with no paid endpoint to fall back to
value.zh: 编程智能体跑在比显存还大的前沿 MoE 模型上，全在自己的台式机里，不会悄悄回落到付费接口

sources: README.md Getting Started → CLI (uv pip install "freetoken[accel]")
docs/install.md (Linux x86_64, NVIDIA driver r580+, CUDA 13; nvcc for JIT kernels)
docs/quickstart.md (ft serve --model ~/models/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B; auto-resolved dtype/backends/cache sizes/parsers; API server on 127.0.0.1:1919; OpenAI and Anthropic routes; ft launch claude)
docs/models.md MoE strategies (offload: experts in host RAM with a GPU LRU cache; cpu; hybrid; auto)
docs/cli.md ft launch (discovers /v1/models, writes provider config, installs CLI if missing, clears ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY from the child env)
